scripts.dev:client: cross-env VITE_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm run dev --workspace client
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build:local: npm run clean && npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && cross-env VITE_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm run build --workspace client
scripts.build:cloud: npm run clean && npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && cross-env VITE_SERVER_URL=http://43.139.223.204:3001 npm run build --workspace client
scripts.deepseek:check: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run deepseek:check --workspace server
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build:cloud && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.electron:dist:mac: npm run build:cloud && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never
